text:
anna: Quick alert: after enabling optimistic quota checks at the edge for lower latency, some customers using older SDKs reported inflated app metrics. Console shows estimates > charges for short windows. Anyone tracking SDK behavior?

mike: saw this on pager. The optimistic change emits X-Quota-Estimate at accept and final charge happens later. Legacy SDKs pre-debit on estimate and don't dedupe retries.

oliver: can we add an explicit header that tells clients whether the edge estimate is authoritative? Something like X-Quota-Authoritative: true|false. If false, SDKs should avoid pre-debit.

jin: platform already emits X-Quota-Mode: optimistic or authoritative. But older SDKs ignore unknown headers. We could also echo an X-Edge-Id to help dedupe.

frances: console impact: customers see two series—"client_estimates" and "server_charges". PM wants clearer labeling and a reconciliation view. Support is getting tickets asking which number to trust.

anna: proposed immediate plan: 1) router adds X-Edge-Id and keeps X-Quota-Mode in canary only 2) SDKs add conservative defaults: no pre-debit unless config.allowOptimistic && server advertises optimistic 3) console adds a migration banner + reconciliation chart for the Canary window 4) telemetry: log quota.estimate_attempt and quota.dedupe_hit.

mike: agree. Additionally, add a short-lived compatibility header X-Quota-Legacy: pre to let older SDKs opt into legacy behavior if necessary. But prefer SDK fix.

oliver: on SDKs: TS and Py can ship a quick toggle. Go has slow downstream releases; will add a local shim honoring X-Edge-Id to dedupe.

jin: sample TS patch idea: when receiving X-Quota-Mode === 'optimistic' and config.allowOptimistic, then pre-debit only if X-Edge-Id not seen before. Also record telemetry with client version.

frances: console UX: add tooltip "Estimates are emitted by the edge and may be optimistic; server charges are final" and an exportable CSV for reconciliation. Also add a message to affected tenants.

anna: timeline: enable headers in canary now, SDK PRs within 24h, console updates in 48h, revisit default after 72h. Meanwhile, rollback option available if noise increases.

deploy-bot: canary deploy started (job 10234) 1:05 UTC.

mike: please add an integration test to sdk-integration-suite that simulates mid-stream failure + retry and asserts charged==1 and dedupe works.

oliver: will open TS/py PRs and a Go draft shim. I'll tag QA for the integration test.

anna: thanks. Also, add a short blurb for support: "When you see estimate>charge, ask for SDK name/version and whether allowOptimisticPredebit is enabled; recommend updating to latest SDK which respects X-Quota-Mode."

frances: noted. I'll update the support playbook and add the console banner copy.

anna: closing loop for now. Keep this thread updated with PR links and any telemetry spikes. :thumbsup:
